title: Open-connection threshold
purpose: 150 clients each hold a connection for 30s, then reconnect, against a threshold of 100 (Cycle's minimum: 'total connections cannot be below 100'). If Cycle counts open connections per instance, one instance sees ~150, two see ~75 each, and it settles at 2. If it counts every connection opened over the window (~3,000 per 10m), it keeps scaling to the max of 5.
